chapter_title: The Spray and the Discovery of Jory
summary: Don Denny arrives at Joe's room with a doctor who finds Joe recovering well. When Denny uses the remaining Ubik spray, he is revealed to be Jory—a grotesquely malformed adolescent who has been consuming the life-force of the group members throughout their half-life. Jory explains that he has 'eaten' Wendy Wright, Don Denny, and others, and that he maintains the pseudo-world of 1939 Des Moines as a stage for his predation. He reveals that the regression was partially his doing but also partly natural decay, and that maintaining the environment exhausts him, forcing him to consume more half-lifers. Joe attacks Jory but is protected by the remaining Ubik. Joe leaves the room to explore and discovers that the world Jory has created is limited in scope—only a few blocks of Des Moines, with details degrading at the boundaries. The chapter reveals the true antagonist and nature of the threat.

themes: Parasitism and predation in spiritual realms
The limits of compassion in the face of evil
Youth and innocence corrupted into monstrosity
